name: Starter Package
audience: Restaurants, patios, storefronts and small commercial frontages
headline: One feature, one controller, fully music-reactive.
summary: The Starter Package puts a single statement prop — a mega tree or a roofline run — in front of your business and makes it react to the music you already play. Everything ships pre-configured; plug in, join the Wi-Fi hotspot and press Play.
controller: Raspberry Pi 5 controller box running LedFx with the Resonate Light Show app
propsIncluded: One mega tree (roughly 8–12 ft) OR one roofline strip run
12 V WS2811 pixels, weather-rated for Ontario winters
Power supply, enclosure, data cabling and mounting hardware
software: Lifetime access to the Resonate Light Show control app, pre-installed on the Pi. Updates included.

name: Business Package
audience: Retail plazas, multi-tenant buildings, venues and property managers
headline: Rooflines, trees and accents working as one show.
summary: The Business Package combines rooflines, one or more mega trees and accent props into a single synchronized display driven by one controller. Choose live music reactivity for everyday ambience and switch to fully sequenced holiday shows when the season arrives.
controller: Raspberry Pi 5 controller box running LedFx with the Resonate Light Show app
pixelController: SanDevices E682 for reactive mode, or Kulp K-series running FPP for sequenced holiday shows
mic: USB microphone with placement tuned to your sound system
propsIncluded: Roofline pixel runs across the primary frontage
One or two mega trees or singing trees
Accent strips for columns, signage or windows
12 V WS2811 pixels, power injection, enclosures and cabling
software: Lifetime access to the Resonate Light Show control app plus our sequencing service for holiday shows. Updates included.

name: Municipal Package
audience: BIAs, municipalities, downtown cores, parks and public squares
headline: A public light show your whole community shows up for.
summary: Built for streetscapes and public spaces: multiple mega trees, singing trees for choreographed holiday programming, and roofline or canopy runs across several buildings — all synchronized. We design for public-space durability, power availability and easy seasonal changeover.
controller: Raspberry Pi 5 controller box running LedFx with the Resonate Light Show app
pixelController: Kulp K-series pixel controllers running FPP for scheduled, sequenced shows (E682 available for reactive zones)
mic: USB microphone for live-reactive zones, plus scheduled playback for sequenced shows
propsIncluded: Multiple mega trees sized to the site
Singing trees for choreographed holiday programming
Roofline, canopy and streetscape pixel runs
12 V WS2811 pixels, weatherproof power and data distribution, lockable enclosures
software: Lifetime access to the Resonate Light Show control app, holiday show sequencing, and seasonal service. Updates included.
